title: Sr. Engineer - IT Operations-3
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Role Overview
   

  

 Zelis is seeking a skilled
 **SQL Production Support Engineer** 
 to support mission‑critical healthcare and payments applications. The role focuses on
 **production support, SQL server operations, incident management, and system reliability** 
 , ensuring high availability and performance of enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for business‑critical applications and databases.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents related to SQL Server, application jobs, and data issues.
* Perform advanced SQL analysis, including query optimization, deadlock analysis, and performance tuning.
* Execute root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and implement preventive measures.
* Support batch jobs, ETL processes, stored procedures, and scheduled SQL tasks.
* Work closely with application, DevOps, DB, and infrastructure teams during incidents and deployments.
* Manage on‑call support, incident escalation, and communication with stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to SLA, compliance, and operational best practices.
* Participate in release support, change management, and production deployments.
* Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Production Support / IT Operations roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (queries, joins, indexing, execution plans).
* Proficient in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
* Solid understanding of database performance tuning, locking, blocking, and deadlocks.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or equivalent).
* Knowledge of monitoring tools and log analysis.
* Understanding of batch processing, data integrity, and transactional systems.
* Ability to work in shift\-based and on\-call environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting payments, healthcare, or financial systems.
* Exposure to ETL tools, SSIS, or data pipelines.
* Basic understanding of .NET applications, APIs, and microservices.
* Familiarity with Azure SQL / cloud\-based database environments.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and change management practices.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Senior Analyst Revenue Mgmt CFS TT
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Techno Functional Analyst with strong hands on experience in Model N Revenue Manager and Oracle Database to support and enhance critical Revenue Management processes, including Chargebacks, Rebates, Managed Care, Government Pricing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical and functional expertise, advanced SQL/PLSQL skills, and a proven ability to analyze and resolve complex data, batch processing, and integration issues within a regulated enterprise environment. The role also includes ownership of AMS coordination and close collaboration with business and delivery teams.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Partner with business users and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non‑functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into solution designs, functional specifications, and implementation plans.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory requirements, and platform best practices.
* Coordinate closely with onsite leads, offshore AMS teams, and external vendors to ensure timely incident resolution and service continuity.
* Provide functional and delivery oversight of the AMS L2/L3 support teams for the Model N application landscape.
* Analyze and resolve batch job failures, performance bottlenecks, and Oracle Scheduler–based processing issues.
* Perform advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL analysis for:
* Data validation and reconciliation
* Defect investigation and resolution
* Ad‑hoc and audit support analysis
* Troubleshoot and support system integrations and interfaces, including:
* PL/SQL‑based inbound and outbound feeds
* High‑volume transactional / EDI‑style data loads and extracts
* Support data fixes, backend loads, and controlled updates across lower and production environments, following established change and governance processes.
* Assist with SIT, UAT, and regression testing, including test scenario creation, execution, and defect triage.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in reports, extracts, and downstream feeds in collaboration with business, integration, and reporting teams.
* Support platform upgrades and regulatory releases by assessing impact, validating customizations, and ensuring data integrity.
* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 10\+ years of experience as a Technical / Techno‑Functional Analyst or Application Support Analyst in enterprise systems.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Model N Revenue Manager, including:
+ Chargebacks
+ Rebates
+ Managed Care
+ Government Pricing
+ Validata
+ MDM

* Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including complex joins, performance tuning, and large‑volume data analysis.
* Experience supporting Oracle Scheduler jobs, batch frameworks, and high‑volume data processing.
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical Revenue Management and gross‑to‑net processes.
* Hands‑on experience with system integrations and data interfaces.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a production‑support, ticket‑driven environment.


**Qualifications**
* Experience with Model N SaaS / AWS‑based deployments.
* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).
* Experience working with cross‑functional stakeholders and external vendors.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
